items.title: Mid-America Apartment Q2 FFO Misses Estimates as Same-Store NOI Falls
items.summary: MAA lags Q2 FFO estimates as same-store NOI declines, but improving lease trends and a steady development pipeline point to stabilizing operations.

items.summary: Invitation Homes outpaces Q2 FFO estimates as higher lease rates, same-store NOI growth and the ResiBuilt acquisition drive revenues, prompting a higher 2026 outlook.

items.summary: ESS tops Q2 FFO estimates as same-property NOI and revenues rise, Northern California outperforms, and its 2026 core FFO outlook is raised.

items.title: UDR Q2 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Leasing Strength, '26 View Up
items.summary: UDR outpaces Q2 FFO estimates, delivers stronger leasing and same-store growth, and raises its 2026 FFO outlook as occupancy and resident retention remain strong.

items.title: 3 Apartment REITs to Buy for Passive Income Before July Ends
items.summary: Multifamily supply is falling off a cliff, and three apartment REITs are paying dividends this month before most investors notice the setup has changed.

items.summary: The “merger of equals” partners raised guidance, following signs of strength in San Francisco and New York City.

items.summary: EQR tops Q2 FFO estimates, lifts its same-store revenue and NOI outlook and highlights stronger leasing trends led by San Francisco and New York.
